payload.body: You tend to notice moments when it is possible to be a little more direct about who you are. A question, introduction, new role, or change in the group gives you room to answer without removing the part that might surprise people. You may still pause because you learned to test whether a room is safe before showing too much. Use one small opening to answer plainly instead of giving the expected version.
payload.astroHint: Lilith sextile the Sun can give you useful openings to show more of your real identity in ordinary situations.

It shows where someone builds confidence, recognizes what gives them energy, and learns to act from the center of themselves rather than from imitation or approval.
